zh-CN.title: 唱片铺的动态纹样
items: 四款歌手气泡加入逐笔绘制的动态纹样：扑克牌飞返、棒球击出后回落、老车绕行星轨、咖啡香气升起。
聊天气泡「典藏」与活动奖池均可预览新动效。

en.title: Animated Record Shop Bubbles
items: Four artist bubbles now draw animated card tricks, a baseball hit and return, a vintage car on a space orbit, and curls of coffee steam.
Preview the animations in Legendary Chat Bubbles or the activity rewards.
